name: Taurus Open Source Load Testing
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source local test orchestration CLI (bzt) for performance and functional testing with JMeter, Gatling, Locust and Selenium; no Taurus software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires installing and configuring underlying test runners; compute, CI infrastructure, target services and optional BlazeMeter hosted reporting can cost money. Free software does not include hosted load generators.
